kept.excerpt: Brand New Day posts 81 percent awareness, up another five points in two weeks, and 69 percent interest, up one. Both are the highest scores on the entire board, and the interest gap isn’t close: nothing else on the chart cracks 52.
kept.publisher: Cosmic Book News, reporting The Quorum tracking published by Puck
kept.relevance: This cutoff-day report provides recent audience awareness and interest measurements, although these survey scores do not directly establish a dollar opening forecast.

kept.excerpt: The July 17 report is titled “Box Office Tracking & Forecasts: SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY ($212-228M+) Check-In; Early Outlooks for THE END OF OAK STREET and INSIDIOUS: OUT OF THE FURTHER.” The publisher states that its forecasts and tracking ranges reflect prerelease trends, are not final predictions, and are subject to revision.
kept.relevance: This recent specialist tracking range lies below the proposed $240 million–$260 million bracket and supplies an independent forecast reference.

kept.excerpt: Boxoffice Pro’s July 10 long-range forecast gives Spider-Man: Brand New Day a domestic opening weekend range of $230 million–$250 million. Its tracking table is marked “As Of 7/10/26.”
kept.relevance: This industry forecast overlaps the lower portion of the target bracket, making it directly relevant to the proposed opening-weekend range.

kept.excerpt: According to Deadline, Spider-Man: Brand New Day is projected to earn between $180-190 million domestically in its opening weekend. In late June, when it was reported that Brand New Day had already earned $40 million domestically just from ticket pre-sales, the indication was that the opening weekend could be as high as $250 million. The Odyssey secured a three-week run, so Brand New Day won’t be able to benefit from IMAX screenings in its opening weekend.
kept.relevance: The article documents a more conservative tracking estimate, strong advance sales, and a premium-screen constraint that could affect the opening gross.

kept.excerpt: Watch the new trailer for #SpiderManBrandNewDay, in theatres July 31. Tickets on sale NOW. July 31, 2026.
kept.publisher: Sony Pictures Entertainment — verified YouTube channel
kept.relevance: The studio’s dated trailer announcement confirms the release schedule and that ticket sales had begun before the experiment cutoff.

kept.excerpt: Sony Pictures said on Thursday that its Spider-Man: Brand New Day trailer has become the most-watched of all time with 718.6m views in its first 24 hours. The data from WaveMetrix showed that interest in the latest exploits of the webslinger starring Tom Holland drew 373m viewers within its first eight hours, overtaking the previous 24-hour record of 365m set by Deadpool & Wolverine in 2024. The trailer dropped on March 18.
kept.relevance: The contemporaneous trailer-viewing record provides an early demand indicator, with an explicit measurement window that predates the cutoff.

kept.excerpt: Sony has confirmed the film’s final Sunday gross of $64.17 million at the domestic box office lifted the latest entry in the Spider-Man franchise to a $260 million debut, making it the second-highest grossing opening weekend of all-time at the domestic box office.
kept.relevance: The preceding Tom Holland Spider-Man film supplies a finalized historical opening-weekend benchmark near the target bracket’s upper boundary, though this article rounds its gross.

search_notes: Frozen evidence cutoff: 2026-07-21. Included only items with explicit publication dates on or before that date; the July 21 Cosmic Book News date was corroborated by its publisher’s dated archive listing. Used web_search to verify indexed source text and dates. web_fetch failed because multiple fetch providers were configured; the requested agent-reach web-read fallback returned RATE_LIMITED, so full-page retrieval was unavailable and excerpts rely on indexed text. The Boxoffice Pro July 10 tracking table appears to mislabel its July 31 Spider-Man row as 'No Way Home'; the article title, surrounding discussion, and contemporaneous coverage identify the forecast as Brand New Day. Excluded undated live box-office totals, later-dated articles, outcome reporting, prediction markets, betting pages, and present-day video engagement counts. Forecasts are attributed to their respective publishers and are not treated as interchangeable or as final results.
